description: Golden briefs for npm run eval:formats: one short sample per format, rendered and scored against the format's cadence target (kit/core/cadence.mjs CADENCE_TARGETS) and the scorecard's metric targets (eval/scorecard.mjs). A sample is an example project (dir), a window of the long-form beat-map fixture (beat-map), or a Short cut from it (short).

briefs.label: Short form
briefs.brief: A 9:16 Short cut from the long-form explainer: opens on a number or a piece of evidence, never a title card; a visual event every 2–3 s; word captions on; loops back to the hook.

briefs.label: Talking-head base edit
briefs.brief: A presenter recording, trimmed, with graphics dressed beside the face and full-frame inserts for the numbers; the face holds the personal lines.

briefs.label: Full art direction
briefs.brief: A narrated product story with a designed world: brand palette and type on every frame, cinematic transitions, a hero shot per beat.

briefs.label: Long-form explainer
briefs.brief: One minute of the 16-minute explainer's direction map: builds of 2–4 states over a chapter plate, a hard cut every 15–25 s, every claim on a sourced visual.

briefs.label: Motion graphics
briefs.brief: A short design-led promo where motion is the message: kinetic type, a stat hit, a process, a logo row, a call to action.

briefs.label: Animated short and long form
briefs.brief: A character-led story: cast acting the key action of each beat in a set, with narration and captions.
